examples.example: Two examples are below for Hindi: Name Term in Hindi Description / term in English Rani बहन mother's brother’s daughter (cousin) (among other possible meanings) Sameer चाचा father's younger brother (uncle) Æ Notice how, quite often, a single word in your mother tongue or regional language requires several words in English to give a precise definition.
